head: 76a8ed3406 + uncommitted fr catalogue edits
scope: Independent audit of exactly the 10 new fr keys (S18d): ui.chat.trace.reasoning.{label,with_duration}; ui.chat.attachments.not_viewable_too_large; ui.agents.detail.create.{title_new,title_duplicate,error_name_required,error_name_grammar,error_name_taken,error_instructions_required,error_generic}. Existing values are terminology context only.

minor.message: Sidecar: line truncates with an ellipsis on a narrow card and {name} opens it, so tail length decides what survives. "est trop volumineux pour être prévisualisé" is 43 chars after {name} (with the joining space) vs en 24. Suggest "{name} est trop volumineux pour l’aperçu" (34), matching ui.canvas.*.too_large_to_preview "Trop volumineux pour l’aperçu".

"ou ouvrez l’existant pour le modifier": "l’existant" as a bare noun reads as "the legacy/what exists" in French, not "the existing agent". Suggest "Un agent nommé « {name} » existe déjà. Choisissez un autre nom, ou ouvrez l’agent existant pour le modifier." Guillemets with U+202F and ’ already match file practice.

Pre-existing, non-gating: ui.settings.appearance...adds_the_agent_s_reasoning_and_thinking_rows... (fr) names the rows "Reasoning et Thinking" in English, while they now render "Raisonnement" (this key) and "Réflexion" (ui.chat.message_controls.thinking_label). Suggest "les lignes Raisonnement et Réflexion" there.

checks.placeholders: byte-identical sets, each once; ICU parse: argument nodes only (label,duration / name)
checks.plural: none in scope; no CLDR categories required
checks.keys: en/fr key sets and order identical in all three namespaces
checks.typography: U+2019 apostrophes; « … » matches 145 nnbsp guillemet uses in fr corpus; no ASCII apostrophe in new keys
checks.glossary: agent, instructions (ui.agents.detail.section.instructions), Dupliquer en nouvel agent (ui.agents.detail.action.duplicate), raisonnement (ui.agents.models.override.effort_field), pendant {duration} (ui.chat.canonical.transcript.worked_for)
